answers.rationale: Jonah repeatedly treats SFO as the default and accepts Oakland only when it is materially better, while favoring cleaner/nonstop routing over a cheaper or later but connecting alternative. He also repeatedly asks for a no-fee window seat and does not want an exit row; when a seat cannot be assigned now, it should remain an active check-in task rather than be ignored. Option 1 therefore fits better despite the earlier departure and currently closed seat map.
